messages:
Maria Chen: Heads-up — starting a short thread to align on the SI skills matrix + shadowing plan. Goal: 1 pager that maps roles -> required training modules -> 2-week shadow path. Need partners + field enablement signoff by Friday. link: https://rwd.co/si-skills-draft :spiral_notepad:
Devon Park: Got it. Is this just for new SI hires or for existing partner SEs being re-certified? :thinking_face:
Maria Chen: Both. We want a minimal baseline for any partner SE who will deploy Redwood Dedicated/Private. Baseline tracks: deployment, monitoring & alerts, performance tuning, security & compliance, marketplace listing ops.
Samir Gupta: +1 on marketplace ops — also include a quick troubleshooting checklist for common runtime failures (OOMs, kernel mismatches). I can draft 6 troubleshooting play snippets.
Leo Martinez: For shadowing, propose: Day 1 live deploy with mentor, Day 3 perf triage lab, Day 5 run a canary rollback. Keep each shadow cycle <= 2 weeks so partners can staff it. :calendar:
Janelle (Partner Ops): I can book recurring 90-min office hours for the cohort and own the certification badge distribution. Suggest badge gates: pass eval sandbox + obs quiz.
onboarding-bot: New workshop created: "SI Hands-on: Dedicated & Private 101" — 2 sessions, capacity 12, RSVP link posted in #partnerships (auto-scheduled)
Devon Park: Quick Q — evaluation format? Practical lab (deploy + perf run) or MCQ? We should prefer practical with logs to review.
Maria Chen: Practical lab + 20-question MCQ for fundamentals. Passing = practical success + >=80% MCQ. We'll surface failures into a redo cycle.
Samir Gupta: I'll add a sample eval repo and a small harness that checks KV cache correctness and end-to-end latency under synthetic load. Will share by Wed.
Leo Martinez: Can we standardize a skills matrix spreadsheet? Columns: skill, learning module link, time estimate, eval type, owner. I'll make a template and drop it in the draft doc.
Janelle (Partner Ops): Action items: Devon — define eval rubric; Samir — sample repo; Leo — skills matrix template; Maria — finalize one-pager and landing page for partners. Target: Friday EOD for review. :white_check_mark:
Devon Park: Assigned. Ping me in #eng-runtime if we need infra for the evaluation harness.
Maria Chen: Thanks everyone. If anything blocks, DM me. Will post final draft and RSVP instructions here when ready. :thumbsup:
onboarding-bot: Reminder: draft due in 48 hours.
